verification_policy: Direct research batch for an indexed skill whose acquisition and core mechanics can be cross-checked without inferring Ultimate Finish requirements.
research_scope: Bending Kamehameha — base-game Ki Blast Super acquisition and core behavior.

verification_audit.acquisition_finding: The current skill reference identifies Bending Kamehameha as a Skill Shop acquisition. A separate GameFAQs answer also directs players to the Skill Shop. No evidence found in the checked sources establishes an Ultimate Finish requirement.
verification_audit.mechanics_finding: The skill costs 100 Ki. Its defining behavior is a second input after firing that makes the beam track/chase the targeted opponent. The in-game description and current skill reference agree on this behavior.
verification_audit.probability_policy: No drop probability is asserted because the researched acquisition route is a shop purchase rather than a documented random PQ reward.

records.name: Bending Kamehameha
records.skill_description: A Ki Blast Super that fires a Kamehameha and can be redirected into a tracking attack with an additional input.
records.mechanics_notes: The current skill reference gives the in-game description as an additional input after firing to make the Kamehameha chase the opponent. The same reference lists beam, tracking, additional input, single-hit and mid-range characteristics and a 100 Ki cost. Exact damage values are not promoted as canonical here because the cited page reports a percentage value without enough version/context detail for a broader mechanics claim.
records.pve_notes: The tracking follow-up makes the skill useful against evasive movement; exact frame data and damage scaling remain a separate mechanics task.
